mods.intro: A Mod is a switchable writing pack bundling prompt template overrides and a guidance addition. Mods are stored globally and shared across books. Manage the library here; enable mods per book in that book's Novel Config → Writing Mods (stackable, later wins). Priority: project custom > global custom > Mod > built-in.

dialogue_scene.name: Dialogue Mode · Scene Generation
dialogue_scene.description: Dialogue mode: write a scene's prose from director's notes (the character-state output protocol is appended automatically and cannot be overridden)

dialogue_distill.name: Dialogue Mode · Scene Distillation
dialogue_distill.description: Dialogue mode: distill a whole scene's chat draft into prose ready for the draft box (output format constraints appended automatically)

deaify_polish.name: De-AI Polish
deaify_polish.description: Detect and rewrite tell-tale AI phrasing to lower AI-detector hit rates while preserving plot, style and length

foreshadow_extract.name: Foreshadowing Extraction
foreshadow_extract.description: After finalizing, extract newly planted foreshadowing from the chapter and identify which open threads it pays off

generate_global_config.name: Global Config Generation
generate_global_config.description: Generate a complete novel configuration JSON from a one-line user idea

premise.name: Story Premise
premise.description: Architecture step 1: distill the story premise, condensing the core selling points and conflict chain

character_dynamics.name: Character Map
character_dynamics.description: Architecture step 2: build core character relationship web and character arcs

world_building.name: Worldbuilding
world_building.description: Architecture step 3: build a world-view matrix with built-in conflict engines

synopsis.name: Synopsis
synopsis.description: Architecture step 4: integrate all fragments and generate a plot outline based on the chosen structure

setting_module.name: Setting Bible · Module
setting_module.description: Write one setting module as four declarative sections (Rules / Exceptions / Drama / Forbidden); with an author instruction, rewrite only what the instruction asks

setting_module_summary.name: Setting Bible · Digest
setting_module_summary.description: Condense one setting module into a ≤150-word declarative summary injected into every chapter and scene prompt

setting_split_worldbuilding.name: Setting Bible · Split from Worldbuilding
setting_split_worldbuilding.description: Split the architecture's worldbuilding into empty modules; leftover rules become new modules, filled modules are untouched

setting_cross_check.name: Setting Bible · Cross-check
setting_cross_check.description: Find contradictions, duplicates and gaps between modules; report only, no edits

directory_full.name: Chapter Blueprint (Full)
directory_full.description: Generate detailed blueprints for all chapters at once based on the full architecture

directory_incremental.name: Chapter Blueprint (Incremental)
directory_incremental.description: Continue generating chapter blueprints from existing ones, supporting chunked generation

first_chapter_draft.name: First Chapter Draft
first_chapter_draft.description: Generate the complete text of the novel's first chapter

next_chapter_draft.name: Subsequent Chapter Draft
next_chapter_draft.description: Generate subsequent chapters based on context and chapter blueprints

refine_chapter.name: Master-Level Revision
refine_chapter.description: Elevate the draft to master-level quality

consistency_check.name: Consistency Review
consistency_check.description: Check the chapter for consistency issues

analyze_writing_style.name: Writing Style Analysis
analyze_writing_style.description: Extract the author's writing style characteristics from prose samples

refine_from_review.name: Review-Driven Revision
refine_from_review.description: Precisely fix draft issues based on the review report

chapter_key_points.name: Chapter Key Points
chapter_key_points.description: Generate structured key points after finalization (plot nodes, character dynamics, new settings, foreshadowing & hooks)

update_character_state.name: Update Character State
update_character_state.description: Analyze chapter content after finalization and return changed character currentState fields in JSON for auto-updating character cards

reverse_config.name: Reverse Engineer Config
reverse_config.description: Reverse-engineer novel configuration, four-part architecture, and protagonist card from existing novel content for continuation scenarios

extract_characters.name: Extract Character Cards
extract_characters.description: Extract structured character card data from character map plaintext for auto-creating character card JSON files after architecture generation

reverse_blueprint.name: Reverse Engineer Blueprint
reverse_blueprint.description: Reverse-engineer structured chapter blueprint from existing chapter prose for import scenarios

vector_enhanced.name: Vector-Enhanced Inference
vector_enhanced.description: Use vector-retrieved content snippets to enhance the accuracy of global configuration inference

promptVariables.step_guidance: Author's supplementary guidance for this step (optional)
